_about: Own-origin gzip KB per request body (level 9), cache off, mobile viewport, 3.5 s settle, measured 7 Oct 2026 against a production build + seeded local stack (run twice, within 1 KB). Budget = measured +5 % rounded up (requests +3). See e2e/route-payload-budget.spec.ts; change a budget on purpose in the same PR. PWA (PR #960, 18 Oct 2026): a page that registers the service worker makes two more own-origin requests, GET /sw.js (the worker script) and GET /offline (the worker's install-time fetch of its offline page). They are NAMED per route in `workerRequests` instead of added to `requests`: headroom is granted only for a named request that actually appears, so one unrelated new request still fails, and a route with no `workerRequests` keeps exactly its old number. All six routes here register the worker (the bootstrap is in the root layout); the embed page does not and has no entry. Measured per route, names only, clean main vs the branch on the same stack: each route gained exactly those two and nothing else. Bytes did not move any KB budget.
